import numpy as np
def fit(cols,label):
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dv_dt-A@c
    print(label, '%.3g'%(np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dv_dt)), c.round(4))
    return c
